summary: P2 Long-Short Quintile Backtest Engine: 8 implementation tasks covering quintile sorting, metrics, IC analysis, long-short spread, attribution, engine orchestration, persistence, and integration tests
approach: Build from bottom up: data models first (IMPL-001), then independent computation modules (IMPL-002 through IMPL-005 can run in parallel after IMPL-001), then orchestration engine (IMPL-006 depends on all), then persistence (IMPL-007), and finally integration tests (IMPL-008). All components use frozen dataclasses for immutability and dependency injection for testability.

conventions: Frozen dataclasses with slots=True for immutability
DataFrame MultiIndex (date, ticker) as data contract
